title: Backend Developer (Data-Intensive)
company: SNT Venture Yazılım ve Teknoloji A.Ş.
description: Genel Bakış SNT Akademi Yazılım ve Eğitim Teknolojileri A.Ş. olarak yüksek hacimli veri işleme, gerçek zamanlı işlem platformları ve güvenli yazılım çözümleri geliştirerek finans sektöründe öncü bir rol üstleniyoruz. Mikroservis mimarisiyle inşa edilmiş, performans ve güvenlik odaklı yazılım altyapımızı güçlendirmek amacıyla veri yönetimi ve dağıtımı konusunda güçlü teknik yetkinliklere sahip bir Backend Developer (Data-Intensive) arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda, .NET Core ve modern altyapı teknolojilerini kullanarak yüksek performanslı arka plan servisleri geliştirecek ve veri dağıtım süreçlerinin (data pipelines & streaming) merkezinde yer alacaksınız. Finansal uygulamalarda gerçek zamanlı veri işleme, kesintisiz veri akışı, canlı veri takibi ve yüksek kullanıcı trafiğine dayanıklı, ölçeklenebilir sistemler tasarlayarak dijital dönüşüm yolculuğumuza katkı sağlayacaksınız. Sürekli entegrasyon, otomasyon ve container tabanlı altyapılarla uyum içinde çalışacak; yüksek hacimli verinin güvenli, tutarlı ve hızlı bir şekilde işlenmesinde aktif rol üstleneceksiniz. Eğer teknik bilginizi sürekli geliştirmeyi seviyor, veri yoğun (data-intensive) ve büyük ölçekli sistemlerin mimarisinde sorumluluk alarak fark yaratmak istiyorsanız, sizi ekibimize bekliyoruz. Sorumluluklar •⁠ ⁠.NET ve C# kullanarak backend servisleri geliştirmek ve mevcut servisleri iyileştirmek •⁠ ⁠RESTful API’ler ve servis entegrasyonları tasarlamak •⁠ ⁠Veri yoğun uygulamalarda performanslı ve güvenilir çözümler üretmek •⁠ ⁠İlişkisel veri tabanları üzerinde sorgu, veri modeli ve performans optimizasyonu çalışmaları yapmak •⁠ ⁠Socket programlama, TCP/IP veya gerçek zamanlı veri iletişimi kullanılan sistemlere katkı sağlamak •⁠ ⁠Kod kalitesi, test edilebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik standartlarına uygun geliştirme yapmak •⁠ ⁠Teknik analiz, hata tespiti ve performans iyileştirme çalışmalarında görev almak •⁠ ⁠Ürün, frontend, DevOps ve diğer yazılım ekipleriyle koordineli çalışmak •⁠ ⁠Code review süreçlerine katılmak ve teknik bilgi paylaşımında bulunmak Aranan Nitelikler •⁠ ⁠Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya Yazılım Mühendisliği lisans mezunu •⁠ ⁠Backend geliştirme alanında 2-4 yıl profesyonel deneyim •⁠ ⁠C# ve .NET ekosistemine hâkim •⁠ ⁠ASP.NET Core ve Web API geliştirme konusunda deneyimli •⁠ ⁠Entity Framework Core veya benzeri ORM araçlarıyla çalışmış •⁠ ⁠SQL ve ilişkisel veri tabanları konusunda deneyimli •⁠ ⁠Veri modelleme, sorgu optimizasyonu ve veri erişim katmanları hakkında bilgi sahibi •⁠ ⁠REST API tasarım prensiplerine hâkim •⁠ ⁠Git tabanlı versiyon kontrol sistemlerini aktif kullanabilen •⁠ ⁠Temiz kod, SOLID prensipleri ve katmanlı mimari konularında bilgi sahibi •⁠ ⁠Temel seviyede socket programlama, TCP/IP, WebSocket veya gerçek zamanlı iletişim bilgisine sahip •⁠ ⁠Analitik düşünebilen, problem çözme becerisi güçlü ve ekip çalışmasına yatkın Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Yetkinlikler •⁠ ⁠PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server veya benzeri veri tabanlarıyla çalışma deneyimi •⁠ ⁠Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka veya benzeri teknolojiler hakkında bilgi •⁠ ⁠Docker ve container tabanlı geliştirme süreçlerine aşinalık •⁠ ⁠Mikroservis mimarileri konusunda deneyim •⁠ ⁠Unit test ve integration test yazma deneyimi •⁠ ⁠CI/CD süreçleri hakkında bilgi •⁠ ⁠Yüksek trafikli veya gerçek zamanlı veri işleyen sistemlerde çalışma deneyimi •⁠ ⁠SignalR, WebSocket veya TCP socket tabanlı uygulama geliştirmiş olmak

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Since 2014, Vitelco has been providing end-to-end Information Technology (IT) services to customers in Turkey and abroad. In addition to offering services in Software Development, Testing, DevOps, and IT Operations, Vitelco also develops its own products and operates as a system integrator for leading solutions in the sector. Driven by the principles of Versatility and Innovation, we aim to deliver comprehensive, flexible, and value-added solutions to our clients. We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our growing technology team and contribute to the design, development, and operation of large-scale, high-performance systems. Responsibilities Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong expertise in C# and .NET for backend development. Proven experience with Angular and TypeScript for modern web application development. Solid understanding of RESTful API design and development. Hands-on experience building and maintaining event-driven microservices architectures . Experience working with Kafka or similar message broker technologies. Strong knowledge of MongoDB and other NoSQL databases. Proven track record of developing, deploying, and supporting high-traffic, large-scale distributed systems in production environments. Experience in application monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and teamwork capabilities. Nice to Have Experience in Android mobile application development . Proficiency in Kotlin . Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Experience with distributed systems and scalability engineering.

title: .NET Full Stack Developer - Banking
description: About the Job Company Description OBSS is Turkey’s largest technology consultancy, pioneering product development and technology consulting for an AI-native future. With more than 20 years of experience and offices in London, Istanbul and Ankara, we empower leading companies in banking and finance, insurance, e-commerce, retail, and the start-up ecosystem. Our team of over 1000 talented professionals thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We are now looking for a .NET Full Stack Developer to join us and contribute to building high-quality, end-to-end solutions that create real business impact. OBSS is looking for a .NET Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team and contribute to delivering end-to-end software payment solutions across diverse industries. You will work on cutting-edge projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality applications that solve real business problems. Main Responsibilities Collaborate with business analysts, project managers, and other stakeholders to understand and define project requirements. Design, develop, and maintain .NET-based applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. Participate in the full software development life cycle, including planning, coding, testing, and deployment. Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and issues in a timely manner. Stay current with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve development processes and technologies. Qualifications / Technical Skills Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or any relevant field. Strong experience with .NET Core, C#, MVC, WebAPI, Entity Framework, and SQL Knowledge of React.js Knowledge of Kubernetes, MSSQL, Redis, and cloud platforms (GCP preferred) Experience with test automation Eager to learn new technologies Good team player with a result-oriented attitude and analytical mindset Strong communication and interpersonal skills High energy and drive Ability to approach AI with curiosity and intention, actively incorporating AI-powered tools into workflows to enhance productivity and drive innovation. Additional Informations : Professional Growth & Learning As a tech company, we focus on reskilling and upskilling to support career growth. We offer a personalized Individual Growth Program (IGP), where employees set clear goals for each half of the year. These goals may include trainings, certifications, and personal development milestones, creating a structured roadmap for continuous improvement. The IGP helps employees strengthen both technical and soft skills, ensuring steady professional advancement. Company Culture and Values We celebrate diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation can flourish. Our culture emphasizes mentorship, knowledge sharing, and active participation in tech communities, workshops, and team events. This vibrant atmosphere empowers employees to contribute their best while feeling supported and valued. Benefits and Perks We provide competitive salaries, flexible and hybrid working arrangements, and a wide range of opportunities for growth through training programs, certifications, and workshops. In addition, we offer initiatives designed to build a supportive and engaging workplace where curiosity and collaboration are encouraged. These benefits ensure that employees feel motivated, empowered, and equipped to reach their full potential.
